text: This report outlines the Toronto Public Health (TPH) 2020 Operating Budget Submission for consideration by the Board of Health. Toronto Public Health's 2020 Operating Budget Submission totals $269,629.5 thousand gross, $69,821.3 thousand net, and 1,919.2 positions. This submission is $12,900.2 thousand gross, $5,944.6 thousand net above the 2019 Operating Budget and reflects a reduction of 13 positions. The gross increase of $12,900.2 thousand from the 2019 Operating Budget is predominately related to the Ontario Seniors Dental Care Program. The net increase of $5,944.6 thousand from the 2019 Operating Budget is predominantly related to the impact of changes announced by the Province regarding the modernization of the public health sector ($4,357.7 thousand); an increase for the Student Nutrition Program to address the increased cost of food ($1,099.5 thousand); and an increase for the…
